title: Green extraction of cellulose fibers from pineapple crown waste for the development of pH-sensitive bioplastic films based on starch and purple cabbage anthocyanins
content:

The starch-based bioplastic films incorporated with purple cabbage anthocyanins with pH sensitivity exhibited distinct color transitions under varying pH conditions, demonstrating their potential as intelligent and biodegradable packaging materials.
